style: Warm, cosy Christmas lifestyle photography, shot on 35mm film, soft natural and fairy-light glow, true-to-life colours, gentle film grain, uncluttered composition, no text, no logos, no watermarks

masks.gramps: a knitted ski balaclava whose face is knitted to look like a grumpy old man with wrinkles, bushy grey eyebrows and a big white moustache
masks.cat: a knitted ski balaclava whose face is knitted to look like a grey tabby cat with pointed ears on top
masks.tiger: a knitted ski balaclava whose face is knitted to look like an orange and black striped tiger with small rounded ears
masks.corgi: a knitted ski balaclava whose face is knitted to look like a tan and white corgi with tall pointed ears
masks.elf: a chunky crochet ski balaclava styled as a Christmas elf: green body, red zigzag collar, small gold bells and pointy knitted ears

shots.for: Product media (first image of each variant)
shots.prompt: A skier wearing {mask} with dark mirrored ski goggles, standing in a ski resort lift line, waist-up, looking straight into the camera, snowy mountains and chairlift softly blurred behind, bright clear winter day
Studio product photo of {mask}, displayed on an invisible mannequin head, straight-on front view, centred, plain warm off-white background (#E8E4DB), soft even studio light, gentle shadow
Candid portrait of a snowboarder wearing {mask} and a helmet with goggles pushed up, sitting on a chairlift, mountain panorama behind, golden late-afternoon light

Five friends at a ski resort, each wearing a different funny knitted ski balaclava (old man with moustache, grey cat, tiger, corgi, Christmas elf), goggles on helmets, laughing and leaning together, chairlift station behind, sunny day, candid moment
Top-down flat lay on fresh snow: {gramps_mask} folded neatly next to a black drawstring pouch and a pair of ski goggles, clean composition, soft daylight
Close-up side profile of a skier wearing {gramps_mask} under a matte black ski helmet with goggles, showing how the balaclava fits under the helmet, snowy background
Extreme macro close-up of thick double-layer knitted acrylic yarn on a ski balaclava, showing the soft brushed fleece lining at the edge of the eye opening, shallow depth of field, warm neutral tones

Wide shot of five skiers walking towards camera on a snowy slope at golden hour, each wearing a different funny knitted ski balaclava (old man, cat, tiger, corgi, elf), skis on shoulders, long shadows, cinematic, lots of empty sky in the upper half
A small round red star projector on a wooden bedside table casting soft golden stars across a dark bedroom ceiling, cosy Christmas evening
A smiling baby in a soft brown reindeer onesie with an antler hood and red nose, sitting on a cream knitted blanket next to a decorated Christmas tree
A young woman laughing in a red ugly Christmas sweater with a green zigzag band and a knitted tree, holding a mug, living room with fairy lights
Six red and gold light-up Christmas baubles glowing on a fir tree branch, close-up, bokeh fairy lights
A red knit Christmas stocking overflowing with small wrapped gifts and funny trinkets, hanging on a white fireplace mantel
Warm-white curtain fairy lights glowing in a living-room window at blue hour, snow outside, cosy sofa in the foreground
A family in matching ugly Christmas sweaters laughing on a sofa, one wearing a funny old-man knitted ski mask, presents and a tree behind, candid moment
